shots.name: Upper-Right Flipper
shots.notes: Catches the skill-shot plunge and combos into Storm, Rogue, Xavier, the right pop bumper, or Wolverine.

shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: A clean plunge avoids tripping the Phoenix switch on the way up; catch the feed on the upper-right flipper for the Skill Shot.

shots.name: Blackbird Scoop
shots.notes: The hub for Mystery, Villain start, and both wizard modes. Extra Ball is awarded here when lit.

shots.name: Rollover Lanes
shots.notes: Primes the Blackbird scoop toward its next Mystery or Villain award.

shots.name: Cyclops Spinner
shots.notes: Fast, chainable switch hits — the quickest single shot on the table for filling Gambit's or Deadpool's counters.

shots.name: Phoenix Orbit
shots.notes: The right orbit. A hard plunge that trips its switch on the way up cancels the base Skill Shot.

shots.name: Beast Orbit
shots.notes: The left orbit, paired with Phoenix as the game's two orbit shots.

shots.name: Xavier Scoop
shots.notes: Professor X's shot. Feeds out through a VUK; also the target for the Super Skill Shot.

shots.name: Wolverine Shot
shots.notes: A door-style mechanism at the heart of the Weapon X multiball, and always lit for a small chip shot during Sabretooth.

shots.name: Magneto
shots.notes: The lock and jackpot shot for Magneto Multiball. Hitting it during the multiball recharges whichever hero shots you've started.

shots.name: Magneto Targets
shots.notes: Two upright targets flanking Magneto; hitting them activates the ball lock.

shots.name: Captive Lock Ball
shots.notes: A shortcut into Magneto Multiball — seven hits (nine the second time in a game) starts it with however many balls are already locked.

shots.name: Hellfire Standups
shots.notes: Left-side standups. Enough hits qualifies Hellfire Club without touching the Blackbird cycle.

shots.name: Brotherhood Standups
shots.notes: Right-side standups. Enough hits qualifies Brotherhood of Mutants without touching the Blackbird cycle.

shots.name: Pop Bumpers
shots.notes: Feed the Gambit and Deadpool counters and can grind out a Storm completion on their own.

shots.name: Right Pop Bumper
shots.notes: The named collection point for Gambit's Hurry-Up, reached by combo off the upper-right flipper.

shots.name: Launch Lanes
shots.notes: Lit return lanes off the ramps — collecting one is one of the fastest ways to keep a villain mode running toward Dark Phoenix.

goals.title: Skill Shot: Storm or Rogue
goals.summary: Plunge clean past the Phoenix switch, then catch the ball on the upper-right flipper and finish at Storm or Rogue for the base Skill Shot.
goals.reward: Skill Shot value

steps.action: Plunge through to the flippers
steps.detail: Bring the ball down to the flippers — the skill shot is made with a flipper.

steps.action: Plunge without tripping the Phoenix switch, then catch it on the upper-right flipper and shoot Storm
steps.detail: Rogue scores exactly the same if that's the shot you catch instead — either one banks the Skill Shot. Clipping Phoenix's switch on the way up cancels it.

goals.title: Super Skill Shot: Xavier
goals.summary: The same clean plunge, finished at Xavier instead for the bigger Super Skill Shot.
goals.reward: Super Skill Shot value

steps.action: Plunge through to the flippers
steps.detail: Bring the ball down to the flippers — the skill shot is made with a flipper.

steps.action: Plunge without tripping the Phoenix switch, then catch it on the upper-right flipper and shoot Xavier
steps.detail: Worth more than the base Skill Shot for the extra precision

goals.title: Prime the Blackbird
goals.summary: The rollover lanes prime the Blackbird scoop for Mystery, and the pattern shifts the more you come back — first completion is Mystery only, second lights Villain, and every pair after that alternates.
goals.reward: A Mystery award every other cycle; Villain lit on the cycles between

steps.action: Roll through the lanes to prime the scoop
Shoot the scoop for your first Mystery award
steps.detail: Picks from a wide table — anything from 500K or a Ball Save up to +25X Bonus or Light Special

steps.action: Prime the lanes again for a second completion
This time the scoop lights Villain instead of Mystery
steps.detail: From here on, every two completions alternates between lighting Mystery and lighting Villain

goals.title: Choose Your Villain
goals.summary: Shooting the scoop with Villain lit doesn't just start a mode — it opens a character-select screen where you choose your fight.
instructions: Shoot the Blackbird scoop once Villain is lit
Use the flippers to move the selection over the villain you want to face
Press both flippers together to confirm, or wait out the 10-second timer to accept whatever's highlighted

Hellfire Club and Brotherhood of Mutants can also be qualified directly at their own standup targets, skipping the Blackbird cycle entirely — and if you qualify one but don't start it, one more shot to its targets relights Villain the fast way
goals.reward: Your choice of villain to fight

goals.title: Side-Door Villain Qualifying
goals.summary: Both standup banks work independently of the Blackbird cycle — clear enough hits on either side and that villain is qualified on the spot.
goals.reward: A qualified villain, ready to fight without touching the Blackbird cycle

steps.action: Work the left-side standups
steps.detail: Enough hits qualifies Hellfire Club directly

steps.action: Work the right-side standups
steps.detail: Enough hits qualifies Brotherhood of Mutants directly

goals.title: Unique Combo: "Sharp Minds!"
goals.summary: One of fourteen named unique combos, and among the easiest to learn: Beast straight into Xavier.
goals.reward: A unique-combo callout, +50k to base combo value after your first, and progress toward the 10-combo extra ball

steps.action: Shoot the Beast orbit
Combo straight into Xavier
steps.detail: Banks the callout and, after your first unique combo of the game, adds 50k to the base combo value permanently

goals.title: Unique Combo: "Unrequited Love"
goals.summary: A three-shot chain that opens on either Storm or Xavier, threads through Phoenix, and finishes at Wolverine.
goals.reward: A unique-combo callout and the same base-value bump as any other unique combo

steps.action: Open with Storm — Xavier works just as well as the starting shot
Continue into Phoenix
Finish at Wolverine
steps.detail: One of fourteen named unique combos on the table

goals.title: The Combo Ladder
goals.summary: Every combo pays a base value plus a bonus per chained shot, and the running tally toward Deadpool and the extra ball builds quietly in the background.
instructions: The base combo value starts at 125k; each additional shot chained on adds 25k, though the chain bonus doesn't carry over once the combo ends
Fourteen named unique combos are each worth a special callout the first time you land them — check the Instant Info screen for your running count
The first unique combo of the game doesn't raise the base value, but every one after that adds a permanent 50k to it
Land ten different unique combos in a game and it lights an extra ball
Every ten combos of any kind — unique or repeated — qualifies Deadpool
goals.reward: Escalating combo scoring, a permanent base-value bump per unique combo, an extra ball at ten uniques, and Deadpool at every ten combos

goals.title: Hire Deadpool
goals.summary: Deadpool is switch-based help for whichever villain you're fighting — hire him at the right moment and he does most of the work for you, minus the final shot.
instructions: Ten combos by default gets Deadpool ready to hire; the playfield flashers pulse once he's available
Hire him during normal play and he activates on the next villain mode you choose; hire him mid-villain-mode and he starts immediately, so it's worth waiting for a fresh fight if you can
Once hired, an internal counter tracks progress — every switch adds 3, every pop bumper hit adds 1, and at 36 Deadpool jumps in and advances the mode for you
The Cyclops spinner racks up switch hits fast and is one of the quickest ways to fill the counter
Deadpool never makes a villain's final shot for you — that one is always yours to land
He stays available until you beat the villain or drain the ball; time out of a mode without draining and he carries over to your next fight
goals.reward: Automatic progress toward whichever villain mode is running, aside from the final shot

goals.title: Nightcrawler
goals.summary: Complete three heroes, then six, and Nightcrawler comes up as its own mode — on Pro, shifting red arrows mark the two or three shots you need.
goals.reward: Extra ball on completion

steps.action: Complete three heroes, then six, to ready the mode
steps.detail: Each threshold arms Nightcrawler independently

steps.action: Follow the shifting red arrow to the left side
steps.detail: Left Nightcrawler is the Xavier scoop or the Storm ramp, whichever the arrow currently points to

steps.action: Or follow it to the right side
steps.detail: Right Nightcrawler is the Iceman ramp; the arrow shifts every few seconds, so don't wait too long to commit

goals.title: Gambit's Hurry-Up
goals.summary: Grind the pop bumpers to arm a rich hurry-up, then thread a specific two-shot combo through the upper-right flipper to actually bank it.
goals.reward: Up to 15M, decaying while you go collect it

steps.action: Hit the pop bumpers to count down the activation
steps.detail: 3k per hit, plus 1k for every hit chained in a row, up to 10k a pop

steps.action: Once the hurry-up activates, shoot Beast first
steps.detail: Starts the countdown at 15M

steps.action: Combo off the upper-right flipper into the right pop bumper
steps.detail: On a steeply inclined machine, just holding the upper-right flipper up can redirect the ball there on its own

goals.title: Magneto Multiball
goals.summary: Activate the lock at Magneto's flanking targets, then lock four balls — or shortcut straight to multiball by hammering the captive lock ball instead.
goals.reward: 50k per started-hero recharge shot, then a Super Jackpot that can climb well past 9M with a full multiball

steps.action: Hit the upright targets on either side of Magneto to activate the lock
Lock a ball at whichever of Phoenix, Rogue or Magneto is flashing
steps.detail: Repeat for all four balls to start the full multiball

steps.action: Or hit the captive lock ball seven times after your first lock
steps.detail: Starts multiball immediately with however many balls are already locked — even two or three. A second Magneto multiball in the same game needs nine hits instead of seven.

steps.action: Hit Magneto at the lock for points and a recharge
steps.detail: Recharges whichever hero shots you've started; started heroes hit far harder than ones you haven't touched

steps.action: Clear roughly 10-12 lit shots to zero out the damage meter
steps.detail: Bringing in more heroes and more balls both raise the eventual Super Jackpot

steps.action: With the meter at zero, shoot Magneto at the lock for the Super Jackpot
steps.detail: Base 4M, plus 400k per started hero, plus 200k per ball beyond two, plus 2M if you've already beaten Magneto once this game — all 8 heroes started adds another 1.6M

goals.title: Wolverine / Weapon X Multiball
goals.summary: A multiball that stacks on top of villain modes — shoot the flashing red path through guards toward a boss shot, then bust the exit door for the payoff.
goals.reward: 250k+ for wrong-path or guard shots, 700k+ for the right path, 900k+ for boss shots, and 2M+ for the exit door

steps.action: Shoot the flashing red shots to advance
steps.detail: Faster-flashing shots move you along quicker; the display shows which half of the table is currently the fast lane

steps.action: Clear an armed guard when one lights
steps.detail: The minimum path to the boss is 3 shots and 2 guards; the maximum runs to 7 wrong-path shots and 6 guards

steps.action: Take down the armed boss wherever it lights
steps.detail: Rotates between Xavier, Magneto and Cyclops

steps.action: Hit any lit shot twice to bust through the final door
steps.detail: Worth 2M plus 2M for every previous Weapon X completion, and adds 3x to the bonus multiplier up to the game's per-ball cap

goals.title: Storm
goals.summary: Storm can finish three completely different ways — take whichever one your ball happens to line up for.
goals.reward: 2-3M for a first completion, up to 3x that on a third clear

steps.action: Shoot the ramp to end the mode outright
steps.detail: The direct route

steps.action: Or rip the spinner until it snows
steps.detail: Enough spins completes the mode on its own

steps.action: Or grind the pop bumpers until lightning strikes
steps.detail: Takes many, many hits, but it counts

goals.title: Villain: Sabretooth
goals.summary: The easiest villain by reputation — hitting the currently lit side flips the fight to the other, and Wolverine is always available for a small, safe chip of damage.
goals.reward: Roughly 9.2M on an optimal full run; damage carries over if you don't finish, though shot progress resets

steps.action: Work the left-side shots as they light
steps.detail: 300k, 500k, 700k, 900k, then 1.1M for the fifth — hitting one moves the lit shots to the other side

steps.action: Work the right-side shots the same way
steps.detail: 300k, 450k, 600k, then 750k for the fourth

steps.action: Chip in Wolverine hits between sides
steps.detail: Always lit, worth just 50k and light damage, but free progress while you line up the next real shot

steps.action: Finish with the final shot once one side leads
steps.detail: Base 4.5M plus 200k per left-side hit, or 4.5M plus 150k per right-side hit if the right side leads instead — a full left-heavy run totals around 9.2M

goals.title: Villain: Shadow King
goals.summary: The hardest villain by reputation — Xavier lights first, and from there you can either shoot Xavier again directly or take whatever hero shot it lights instead, on repeat.
goals.reward: 450k stepping to 2.25M across five shots, then 5M to finish

steps.action: Shoot Xavier to advance — or wait for it to light a hero shot and take that instead
steps.detail: Either path advances the mode identically

steps.action: Take the lit hero shot if that's the one you go for
steps.detail: Any hero shot can be the one that lights

steps.action: The final shot must be Xavier himself
steps.detail: Restarting the mode resets the shot progression back to 450k even though damage is saved

goals.title: Face All Seven Villains
goals.summary: Seven villains stand between you and Dark Phoenix, and each one plays completely differently — here's the shape of every fight.
goals.reward: 5M-12M for a non-multiball villain completion; more for the multiball villains

steps.action: Sabretooth: alternating side shots and free Wolverine chips finish him for around 9.2M
Shadow King: ping-pongs off Xavier until a 5M final shot closes it out
Hellfire Club: a multiball — clear three waves of gunmen by shot position, then finish Sebastian Shaw for 4M
steps.detail: Keep the multiball alive and you can face him again

steps.action: Juggernaut: six hits strip his helmet — Rogue and Storm count double — then Professor X finishes him for 4M plus 5x the banked jackpot
Brotherhood of Mutants: a multiball — defeat Toad, Blob, Pyro, Avalanche, then Mystique in that exact order for 4M
steps.detail: They respawn afterward for as long as the multiball stays alive

steps.action: Sentinels: any lit shot damages whichever side it's aimed at; four kills at 2M each finishes it
Omega Red: free whichever hero he's holding, then repeat as he grabs someone new — two at once near the end
steps.detail: Shots climb from 500k to 2.5M, then 5M to finish

goals.title: Wizard Mode: Danger Room
goals.summary: Professor Xavier's training room, across four escalating levels — destroy the lasers, flamethrowers and tentacles marked by the lit character inserts before the balls in play catch up with you.
goals.reward: Up to 110M across all four levels; a failed run keeps your completed heroes lit but the mode itself can't be restarted

steps.action: Qualify Danger Room
steps.detail: With Hero Stacking off, complete all eight heroes — Magneto doesn't factor in. With it on, start every hero before Magneto Multiball, then win a max 4-ball Magneto and claim the Super Jackpot.

steps.action: Level 1: clear Beast, Phoenix and Magneto for 2M each
steps.detail: Finishing them lights the Blackbird for 2M and opens the next level

steps.action: Level 2: a two-ball multiball — clear Beast, Xavier, Magneto, Iceman and Phoenix for 3M each
steps.detail: Finish at the Blackbird for another 3M

steps.action: Level 3: a three-ball multiball — clear Hellfire, Beast, Xavier, Magneto, Iceman, Phoenix and Brotherhood for 4M each
steps.detail: Finish at the Blackbird for another 4M

steps.action: Level 4: a four-ball battle with Danger itself — Storm, Rogue, Xavier and Iceman pay 4M, 6M or 8M, with Brotherhood and Hellfire worth 1M each
steps.detail: Danger has no damage meter to track — just keep shooting

goals.title: Wizard Mode: Dark Phoenix
goals.summary: Defeat every villain and Dark Phoenix lights at the Blackbird. Getting there fast is mostly about staying in a villain mode as often as possible.
goals.reward: Access to Dark Phoenix, the game's final wizard mode

steps.action: Work through all seven villains
steps.detail: Every defeat pushes you a step closer to lighting Dark Phoenix

steps.action: Line up the Launch lanes on every ramp return
steps.detail: Collecting one whenever it's lit is one of the fastest ways to keep a villain running

steps.action: Qualify Hellfire and Brotherhood early, but hold off starting them
steps.detail: Once qualified, a single shot to either target relights Villain without spending the multiball — the quickest relight in the game

steps.action: With every villain defeated, Dark Phoenix lights at the scoop
steps.detail: What happens once it starts isn't detailed here — only that it's worth the trip

goals.title: Eight Heroes, Eight Ways to Clear
goals.summary: Start any hero by shooting their shot twice — Wolverine is the exception — but each one finishes a different way once it's running.
instructions: Beast: shoot Beast twice to start, then finish by shooting Beast again, hitting the pop bumpers enough to rattle his beakers, or some mix of both
Xavier: match the mutant outline shown on the DMD by shooting the right hero shot directly — or shoot Xavier a second time to reveal the answer, for a smaller reward
Rogue: shoot three different hero shots to gain their powers, or just shoot Rogue outright to finish it with or without the others
Storm: finish at the Storm ramp directly, or grind it out at the Cyclops spinner or the pop bumpers instead
Cyclops: shoot Cyclops, then combo the upper-right flipper into Storm, Rogue, Xavier, the right pop bumper, or Wolverine
Iceman: two ramp shots clears it outright
Phoenix: two orbit shots clears it directly, or grind it out at Cyclops (6 hits) or Wolverine (many more)
Wolverine: its own multiball rather than a simple twice-and-done mode — see Weapon X
Starting a hero a second time takes 6 shots instead of 2; a third time takes 9. Completing a hero adds 3 to the bonus multiplier, and repeat clears in the same ball stack that bonus again
goals.reward: 2-3M per completion, doubling on a second clear and tripling on a third

achievements.title: Side Door

achievements.title: Bamf
achievements.desc: Complete Nightcrawler and light the extra ball.

achievements.title: Let It Snow
achievements.desc: Complete Storm through any of its three finishing paths.

achievements.title: Fifteen Million And Counting
achievements.desc: Combo into the right pop bumper to bank Gambit's Hurry-Up.

achievements.title: Claws Retracted
achievements.desc: Defeat Sabretooth in a single run.

achievements.title: Metal Storm
achievements.desc: Zero Magneto's damage meter and collect the Super Jackpot.

achievements.title: Through Every Door
achievements.desc: Bust through the exit door and complete Weapon X multiball.

achievements.title: Mind Over Mutant
achievements.desc: Defeat Shadow King, widely considered the hardest villain on the table.

achievements.desc: Defeat all seven villains in a single game.
